name: John J. Keeshan
summary: Corporal John J. Keeshan is a human soldier of Stormwind's army who fought the Blackrock orcs in the Redridge Mountains. After being captured during the fighting around Stonewatch, he was dragged deep into Render's Rock as a prisoner of war.

sections.title: A Soldier of Redridge
sections.body: John J. Keeshan is a corporal in the service of Stormwind, posted to the Redridge Mountains as the Blackrock orcs pressed against Lakeshire and its defenders. When the fighting flared up around Stonewatch Keep, Keeshan was in the thick of it alongside the other soldiers holding the line for the kingdom.

sections.title: Captivity at Render's Rock
sections.body: When the Blackrock clan pushed north out of the Burning Steppes into the Redridge Mountains, Keeshan stood among the defenders battling for Stonewatch Keep. Overwhelmed by the orcish assault, he was captured alive rather than slain on the field. The Blackrock invaders hauled him captive into the depths of Render's Rock, leaving the veteran imprisoned behind enemy lines until Alliance rescue parties could fight their way in to break him out.

faq.answer: John J. Keeshan is a corporal of Stormwind's army who fought the Blackrock orcs in the Redridge Mountains. During the battle around Stonewatch Keep he was captured and dragged away to Render's Rock.

faq.q: Why is Keeshan imprisoned in Render's Rock?
faq.answer: During the battle against the Blackrock clan around Stonewatch Keep, Keeshan was overwhelmed, captured alive by the orcs, and hauled back to their encampment inside the caves of Render's Rock.

angles.text: Keeshan represents the steep human cost of the Alliance's war against the Blackrock orcs in Redridge, a soldier taken captive while holding the line for Stormwind.
For warriors, Keeshan is a grim testament to the dangers of the Redridge front, where even hardened soldiers can be overwhelmed and dragged off by the Blackrock clan.
